admission.justification: One normative Rule8 visibility-to-space obligation connects the shared widget, hidden resizable panels, shell track calculation and page-edge control placement. Frame continuity or tree navigation alone cannot prevent a hidden panel retaining width or stranding its toggle. The review chat track/overlay branch is its Rule11 specialization, not a separate chat-lifecycle assertion.

applicability: The dashboard-owned Operations left/right rails; Knowledge tree and outline/citation aside where its responsive layout shows them; File Viewer explorer; change-set changed-file rail; Notes/requirements rail where present; and review tree/chat sidebars.
conditions: The native SidebarToggle is named for its sidebar, exposes aria-expanded and stays outside the sidebar being hidden; a notes view without a rail draws no rail toggle.

Operations puts its left/right controls at the main-column edges and removes each hidden rail track from the grid. With no rail tracks the main uses minmax(0,1fr); otherwise it keeps its existing380px minimum. At40rem and narrower the shell is one column without overwriting the stored rail widths.

Notes/Knowledge hide their mounted resizable panel and its handle together; the panel leaves the row, becomes aria-hidden/inert, and the handle is disabled, so the main content takes the released width.

Knowledge hides its toggle line at40rem and narrower and its right toggle at70rem and narrower, preserving its existing responsive Browse/citation-page policy rather than showing a control for an absent beside-text pane. Opening a citation first opens a user-hidden aside.

The review chat takes its current width only when open with grid placement; closed and overlay placement keep a zero chat track and the current14px/12px gutter. Below1440px the open column overlays the reader; at40rem and narrower the shell is one column and the chat is viewport-capped.
An overlying review chat exposes its own shared close control at its edge because it may cover the reading column's toggle.

File Viewer puts its Explorer sidebar toggle in the external toolbar; the same state hides its outer mounted explorer panel and resize handle together, leaving the DualPane as the outer group main panel.

The change-set page puts its Changed files sidebar toggle in the external header; the same state hides the mounted file-list panel and handle in its current panel group. A horizontal group releases file-list width to the remaining diff/partner content; the narrow vertical group removes that stacked list without removing the main or optional partner panes.

The review tree toggle is first in the reading head, outside the tree. Closing sets the tree grid track to0px, marks the retained tree aria-hidden and invisible, removes its handle, and at40rem and narrower removes its stacked display. Showing restores that retained tree rather than remounting its contents.

Page/side open-state keys and the review chat closed-first exception remain the separate visibility-state policy; numerical tree/chat class defaults, resize bounds and saved values remain the separate numeric-width policy. The separate shared-control policy owns only the shared control and visibility-to-layout behavior.
exclusions: The all-page storage/persistence policy and review-chat open-lifetime exception; those are not broadened or certified by this bounded visibility/width record.
Frame retention, generation/task binding and agent creation, which remain INV-VMREN3 and its neighboring existing obligations.
Review tree navigation/pinned content (INV-WR2WAJ), marker return (INV-DFS1CC), and reading/tree scroll owners (INV-811GC5).
General Notes rendering, citation target/address semantics, Browse policy changes or a new citation UI.
Fresh computed browser-width, wheel/touch, horizontal-overflow or page-jump acceptance measurements.
